answer.rationale: Incumbent has refused to renegotiate, so memory_c4 (renegotiating with incumbent recovered margin) does not apply this cycle. Finance mandate requires 18% cost cut. Memory_c2 shows low-cost vendor delivered sharply lower unit cost last year with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, supporting a switch. Switching carries delivery risk, but c3 shows adding a second source removes single-point-of-failure risk; combining switch with parallel qualification gives the best cost outcome while controlling delivery risk under the 94% utilization constraint. Defer (c5) is insufficient given the 14-day expiry and finance mandate; renew (c1) cannot meet the 18% cut. Verify c2 and c4 before committing, but current intent is switch_primary_vendor.
